slides.sample_notes: ROUND 2 — PATCH NOTES: REALITY UPDATE (25–30 minutes). Open the companion offline HTML game. Select Elementary A2–B1 or Advanced B2–C1. Each mode contains 20 original scenarios, but it is not necessary to play all 20 in this time window: use approximately 6–10, depending on discussion. One host controls the screen. Participants speak together; there are no scores or written answers. On this slide, introduce the four concepts: glitch, choose one patch, reveal its consequence, then keep or reset.

fields.sample_text: No teams. No scores. Just spontaneous English!

slides.sample_notes: Host rules: (1) Read the Glitch from the HTML game aloud. (2) Let the group discuss both patches using the Toolkit; avoid rushing shy speakers. (3) Once the group chooses A or B, click that patch; only that patch’s consequence is revealed. Invite surprise, laughter and reconsideration. (4) Choose KEEP to live with the patched world, or RESET to return to ordinary reality, then click Next Glitch. One host operates the browser; other players simply speak. No points, typing, timers or individual phones. Use the Elementary or Advanced level appropriate for your table.
